description: Everything that needs attention in the member's Kliqo workspace, checked in one call: visibility change this week and this month, who moved ahead, prompts AI answers without naming them, sites where competitors get cited instead, the most valuable open actions, results of finished actions, AI crawler errors and whether answers are still coming in, with suggested next steps. Use when the member asks how their brand is doing in AI answers, what changed, or what to work on. Needs sign-in to Kliqo (read-only).
